jurisdiction_name: NO COLLEGE HILL WARD 1 (NORTH COLLEGE HILL City)
narrative: No College Hill Ward 1 (City of North College Hill) has 1,836 registered voters, with 62.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 9.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 27.8%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 18.4 percentage points.
